stories.title: Generate Article JSON-LD schema with author, datePublished, and dateModified for all blog posts
stories.description: Implement Article structured data for blog posts to improve SEO visibility and enable rich snippets in search results. Schema will include author, headline, description, image, datePublished, and dateModified fields.
acceptanceCriteria: Article schema includes author (Organization), headline, description, datePublished, dateModified, articleBody, image, and url properties matching schema.org/Article spec
Schema is injected into <head> of /blog/[slug] routes via StructuredData component and validates as valid JSON-LD
All blog post frontmatter includes publishedDate and modifiedDate fields in YYYY-MM-DD format
technicalNotes: Create lib/schemas/articleSchema.ts with generateArticleSchema(post, baseUrl) function
Update app/blog/[slug]/page.tsx to call generateArticleSchema and render via <StructuredData> component
stories._rejection_reason: too_simple: only 0 measurable ACs -- specify test commands, file paths, or numeric thresholds

stories.title: Add JB News & Updates widget to homepage displaying latest 5 curated RSS items
stories.description: Create a server component that fetches from 3-5 curated RSS feeds (JB City Council, MyMetro, Tourism Malaysia) and displays latest items on homepage between hero and amenities sections with loading skeleton and error boundary.
acceptanceCriteria: Widget fetches from configured RSS feeds and renders 5 most recent items with title, 100-char snippet, link, and publishedDate
Component at app/components/JbNewsWidget.tsx displays loading skeleton during fetch and graceful error message if feed fetch fails
Widget integrated into app/page.tsx between hero section and amenities section with responsive layout
technicalNotes: Create lib/rss/feedSources.ts with array of feed URLs and lib/rss/fetchFeeds.ts with async fetchRssFeeds() function
Use rss npm package to parse XML feeds with 5-second timeout per source

stories.title: Create /blog/[category] landing pages with CollectionPage schema for long-tail blog SEO
stories.description: Build category-specific blog landing pages (e.g., /blog/travel-guides, /blog/work-guides) that list all posts in category with pagination and CollectionPage JSON-LD schema for Google rich results.
acceptanceCriteria: Pages at /blog/[category] display 10 blog posts per page with pagination; each post shows title, excerpt (100 chars), image, publishedDate
Each category page includes CollectionPage JSON-LD schema with hasPart array listing all posts of that category type
Navigation allows filtering by travel-guides, work-guides, gig-jobs, visa-runs categories via dropdown or breadcrumbs
technicalNotes: Create app/blog/[category]/page.tsx with getPostsByCategory(category) helper from lib/blog/getPostsByCategory.ts
Implement CollectionPage schema in lib/schemas/collectionSchema.ts and inject via StructuredData

stories.title: Implement dynamic blog post sitemap generation with lastmod timestamps
stories.description: Update app/sitemap.ts to automatically include all /blog/[slug] routes with lastmod timestamps from blog post frontmatter. Ensures search engines re-crawl updated posts.
acceptanceCriteria: sitemap.ts generates entries for all blog posts at /blog/{slug} with lastmod from post.modifiedDate, changefreq=weekly, priority=0.7
Sitemap includes ≥6 blog post entries in valid XML format with lastmod in ISO 8601 format (YYYY-MM-DD)
Helper function lib/blog/generateSitemapEntries.ts(allPosts) returns SitemapEntry[] objects with url and lastmod
technicalNotes: Update app/sitemap.ts to import and call generateSitemapEntries(allBlogPosts) and merge results
Create lib/blog/generateSitemapEntries.ts utility that maps blog post metadata to sitemap format

stories.title: Add 'Related Posts' section to blog articles using tag-based similarity matching
stories.description: Implement a Related Posts component appearing at end of blog articles, showing 3-4 posts with matching tags. Improves internal linking for SEO and user engagement.
acceptanceCriteria: Component app/components/RelatedPosts.tsx accepts currentPostSlug and renders up to 4 related posts in responsive grid (1 col mobile, 2 col desktop)
Related posts selected by highest tag overlap (≥1 shared tag with current post); excludes current post and unpublished articles
Each related post card displays title, 80-char excerpt, cover image, publishedDate, and link to /blog/[slug]
technicalNotes: Create lib/blog/getRelatedPosts.ts with getRelatedPosts(currentSlug, allPosts, maxResults=4) using tag intersection scoring algorithm
Update app/blog/[slug]/page.tsx to render <RelatedPosts currentSlug={slug} /> before footer section
